description: This file contains unit tests for CLI commands in the 'cli' package, including tests for command creation, argument parsing, environment setup, and command execution validation.

methods.name: TestListCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'list' CLI command to verify it executes correctly without errors.

methods.name: TestStopCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'stop' CLI command, including argument validation and error handling.

methods.name: TestConfigCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'config' CLI command, mainly to verify command structure and invocation.

methods.name: TestAddCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'add' CLI command for argument validation and execution.

methods.name: TestMCPCommand
methods.description: Verifies the 'MCP' command structure and execution.

methods.name: TestVCCommand
methods.description: Verifies the 'VC' command structure and execution.

methods.name: TestVersionCommand
methods.description: Tests the version command with provided version info.

methods.name: TestUninstallCommand
methods.description: Tests the uninstall command's argument validation and execution flow.

methods.name: TestLogsCommand
methods.description: Verifies the 'logs' command for correct argument handling and structure.

methods.name: TestInitCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'init' command to ensure correct execution and idempotency.

methods.name: TestRootCommandFlags
methods.description: Checks that global flags (e.g., verbose, port, storage mode) are correctly parsed and set in the root command.

methods.name: TestRootCommandInvalidArgs
methods.description: Verifies that invalid command inputs produce errors.

methods.name: TestRootCommandConfigFile
methods.description: Tests processing of a configuration file passed via the '--config' flag.

methods.name: TestFrameworkCommands
methods.description: Ensures that framework-related commands ('install', 'run', 'dev') are present in the CLI command structure.
